lines.text: Your life is a movie. And right now, you're the main character.
Most people let someone else write their script.
Their parents. Their friends. Their fears.
So they end up as an extra, in their own story.
Same scene. Every single day. Waiting for the plot to change.
But the plot doesn't change, until you do.
Write the scene where you wake up early.
Where you fall, and get back up.
Where everyone doubted you, and you kept going.
Every great movie has a hard part in the middle.
That's not your ending. That's your comeback.
So stop watching your life from the audience.
